additional_info.subject: Status Update : 18/04/2025
additional_info.body:
Awaiting for next site intervention
Activity on 17th April
Checked both IMD configuration and found all Okay
Checked charging session with both the outlet and observed
DC1 fail at cable check with IMD fault
DC2 failing during power delivery after closing QA9-10 with IMD fault
Removed all authentication method from the charger made it freecharging mode
Reduced DC2 max power to 80kW to not engage DC1 in charging process
Found DC2 is able to charge the EV without any IMD fault -
Successful charging session on DC2
Concluded there is an issue from DC1 group or connection which causing the IMD fault while a voltage buildup
Planned remove all converter from DC1 and try trial and error method on outlet 1
Due to unavailability of EV at site, plan dropped
Discussed with Basheer to have an another intervention with EV to find the root cause of the issue

RC cancelled the intervention on 26th June.
Observed charger was in failsafe mode after the FW update (RC informed there is another ticket for the FW update and will coordinate with the case manager to rectify the issue).

additional_info.subject: Status update:
additional_info.body:
After the intervention today, both outlets are working again.
We found out that one of the DC1 cables connected to bus bar, was very close to the frame. After bending it a little to be far way from the housing the outlet 1 was working. We did several successful tests with outlet 1 and 2.
